finalRubric.name: Agent-readability (open standards), 100 points
bands: Structured data 40 - complete Product schema (Product/ProductGroup + price + availability) = 40; schema present but missing price or availability = 20; none = 0
Heading clarity 20 - exactly one h1 = 20; two h1 = 10; three or more, or zero = 0
Named controls 20 - zero unnamed buttons = 20; one to three = 10; four or more = 0
Image alt text 20 - 95% or more of img elements carry an alt attribute = 20; 80 to 94% = 10; under 80% = 0
finalRubric.note: Measured on the rendered DOM of one product page, one load, automated Chromium. A blocked page is not scored.
